slides.narration: Okay, this is EIGHT Roblox clients, running at the same time, on one PC. And the app doing it is free.
Meet RoRoRo! Save every alt once, then it's one click each, with live status and the game each one is actually in.
Squad Launch is the best part. One link, and every single account lands in the SAME private server, together.
And it keeps score! Peak alts at once, total uptime, a leaderboard of your alts with login streaks. All computed on your machine, nothing leaves it.
Four built-in themes, plus a theme builder where an AI designs you a custom one from a vibe description.
Your password never touches the app, ever. And there's a pile of quality of life on top. Just read the list!
Free on the Microsoft Store, Windows AND Mac. Scan the code, save the page, grab it on your desktop. RoRoRo, from six-two-six Labs!
